Latitude correction: > 50°N in winter = multiply target × 1.5 (less efficient UV)
Seasonal factor: winter (DJF) = 1.3×, spring/fall = 1.0×, summer = 0.7×
UV efficiency: UV < 3 = 0 D3 synthesis, UV 3-5 = partial, UV 5+ = full
Supplement offset: D3 1000 IU/day reduces outdoor target by 15%
BMI factor: BMI > 30 = 1.2× (Vitamin D sequestered in adipose tissue)
Cloud factor: overcast 80%+ cloud = 0.3 efficiency, 50% = 0.6, < 20% = 1.0
Altitude factor: sea level = 1.0×, 5000ft = 1.15×, 10000ft = 1.3×
Fitzpatrick daily base mins at UV 5, midday, summer: I=8, II=12, III=18, IV=25, V=35, VI=50
All formulas accompanied by medical disclaimer and 'consult physician' note
